# homeassistant_lovelace_resource (Resource)

A Lovelace resource: a URL that the frontend loads on every dashboard, such as the JavaScript of a custom card. Home Assistant must keep its resources in storage (the default), not in YAML.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The JavaScript of a custom card, e.g. one installed with HACS, so dashboards can use it.
resource "homeassistant_lovelace_resource" "button_card" {
  url  = "/hacsfiles/button-card/button-card.js"
  type = "module"
}

resource "homeassistant_dashboard" "home" {
  url_path = "my-home"
  title    = "My Home"
  config = {
    views = [{
      type  = "sections"
      title = "Home"
      sections = [{
        type  = "grid"
        cards = [{ type = "custom:button-card", entity = "light.kitchen" }]
      }]
    }]
  }

  depends_on = [homeassistant_lovelace_resource.button_card]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) How the frontend loads it: `module` (a JavaScript module, what most custom cards are), `js` (a classic script), or `css` (a stylesheet).
- `url` (String) URL of the file, e.g. `/hacsfiles/button-card/button-card.js` or `/local/my-card.js`. Changing it updates the resource in place. Creating or updating fails if another resource has this URL; import that one instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID that Home Assistant assigned to the resource. Import with this ID or with the URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Lovelace resource by its ID, or by its URL.
tofu import homeassistant_lovelace_resource.button_card 3b8f1c0e9d2a4f6b8c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d
tofu import homeassistant_lovelace_resource.button_card /hacsfiles/button-card/button-card.js
```
